description_ar: عد تنازلي مثير: أرقام ضخمة ترتد، دوائر نبض، شريط تقدم، وانفجار نجوم في النهاية.
description_en: Exciting countdown: giant bouncing numbers, pulsing rings, a progress bar and a star burst finale.
scene_blueprint_en: One scene per second for the numbers (1 s each) with a bounce entrance and a ring that shrinks.
Final scene: 'GO!' text with elastic zoom + star particles moving up fast.
rules_en: Numbers in Lalezar at 0.5 x the shorter side; digits written in Arabic-Indic (٥٤٣٢١) unless the brief says otherwise.
Use a progress-bar at the bottom that advances per scene (value animated from i/n to (i+1)/n).
